purpose: M6-seal-story 'what is truly live' table. Source-of-truth snapshot of the ratification state of every pluggable audio-plane seam on disk as of CP-M6-6-4 seal. Populated per Rec-3-M6SW6 owner ruling 2026-09-15T~21:25Z verbatim: 'the M6-seal-story what is truly live table'.

provenance.seam_enumeration_method: Filesystem scan of services/audio_plane_v1/*.py for the string '[INFERRED-pending-ratification]' via grep -rln. Every seam module carrying the marker is enumerated. Case-agnostic (no coupling to specific class names).
provenance.canon_anchors_source: Module-declared primary discharge anchor read verbatim from each seam module's docstring on disk.
provenance.no_live_invocation: This snapshot is METADATA-ONLY per §E.5 sub-wave 6 grounding brief. No backend is called. No seam is exercised. The snapshot records what is on disk, not what has ever executed.

codec_note: The audio-codec service (services/perception/audio_codec/ · CP-M6-4-1..4-4) is a SERVICE (skeleton + census_visibility + perimeter_boundary + service.py + artefact.py) rather than a pluggable-backend seam of the D10 shape. It does not expose an UnratifiedInferredBackend placeholder or an [INFERRED-pending-ratification] marker in its modules on disk at snapshot time, therefore it is NOT enumerated as a registry entry. If a future CP wires an in-perimeter tenant-compute codec backend into a pluggable seam shape, that seam will register at that CP's seal and this snapshot will refresh.
read_surface_contract:
Consumers of this snapshot should:
  1. Read `seams` array in insertion order (matches Rec-3-M6SW6 verbatim 'deterministic output').
  2. Filter by `ratification_state` to build the 'what is truly live' (== 'ratified') and 'pending owner ratification' (== 'inferred_pending_ratification') tables.
  3. Treat this snapshot as METADATA-ONLY (§E.5). It is not an authorisation surface — live-invocation refusal is enforced inside each seam's UnratifiedInferredBackend class per D10.
next_ratification_cycle_gate: Each seam listed with ratification_state='inferred_pending_ratification' needs an owner-ratification event to flip to 'ratified'. Owner ratification lands as: (i) a specific model choice per seam (e.g. fastText LID.176 for language_identifier), (ii) a ratified_at_utc timestamp (ISO-8601), (iii) a track-a commit banking the ratified backend class (subclass of the seam's Backend Protocol). Once banked, this snapshot refreshes and services.audio_plane_v1.backend_registry.register_backend(...) records the new entry.
